# A receivable credit whose `lot_owner:` states an employee.
#
# `lot_owner:` puts a split in a lot of a customer's or a vendor's, the two
# owners the format writes. An employee is neither, so nothing can put the
# split in a lot of theirs.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the transaction.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_lot_owner_that_is_no_customer_or_vendor_is_refused.py.
2026-01-05 * "Prepayment owned by an employee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 50.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00 CAD
		lot_owner: "employee:E001"
